name: The Platform Group AG
summary: The Platform Group AG is a software enterprise dedicated to operating online marketplaces for both business-to-business (B2B) and business-to-consumer (B2C) clients. Its activities are structured across four main divisions: Consumer Goods, Freight Goods, Industrial Goods, and Service & Retail Goods. The company manages a diverse range of digital platforms serving various industries, including fashion (shoes, apparel, bags, jewelry), mobility (bicycles, automotive, e-mobility), industrial machinery, home furnishings, education, specialized services (pharmacy, dental, hairdressers), forestry, gardening, and sustainability initiatives. Geographically, it maintains a significant presence in Germany, the Netherlands, Austria, Switzerland, France, Italy, Spain, the United Kingdom, Poland, Belgium, Ireland, and numerous other international markets. Established in 1882, the firm is based in Düsseldorf, Germany, and was previously known as Fashionette AG before adopting its current name in November 2023.
